opportunities.point: Management expects the Dahej facility to reach a minimum 50% to 60% capacity utilization in its first full financial year of operations.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "I would say when we talk about next financial year, which is the first full year of operations, we should be looking at minimum 50% to 60%." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: The company targets an EBITDA margin of approximately 14% supported by higher-value products.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "So, going forward, our target would be to get to an EBITDA margin level of about 14% to 15% with the higher share of value-added products that we are foraying into now." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: The Dahej greenfield chemical facility in Gujarat involves an investment of about INR100 crores with an estimated revenue potential of INR900 crores.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "With an investment of about INR100 crores, the estimated revenue potential will be INR900 crores." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Phase 1 of the Dahej plant will have a capacity in the range of 15,000 tons to 17,000 tons per annum.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "in the first phase, it would be in the range of 15,000 tons to 17,000 tons." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Current utilization levels are in the early 80s.

threats.point: Peers earn a better ROCE - the competitive position looks weaker.

threats.evidence: FII -0.56 pp, DII -1.03 pp over the recent quarters

threats.point: The stock has drawn down sharply in the past.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Ongoing geopolitical conflicts severely impacted global supply chains for zinc dross, the company's primary raw material, during the last quarter.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "As we had mentioned earlier, the ongoing geopolitical conflict had impacted global supply chains for Zinc Dross, which is our primary raw material." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

threats.point: Management noted global supply chain disruptions during the recent months.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Despite global supply chain disruption, JGC's scale, financial strength and long term supplier relationships have ensured uninterrupted supply of raw material during the last few months." (concall ppt - 2026-08-01)

threats.point: During March, there was a complete freeze in imports from the Middle East and huge delays in shipments from Europe.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "During the month of March, there was a complete freeze in imports from the Middle East and also there were huge delays in shipments from Europe." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)
